note: Committed cost ESTIMATE for one full U11 exit-gate run — the five consolidation ops, U21's vision seat, and the judge that grades them. No model was called to produce it: every number is computed from src/ai/pricing.ts by evals/exit-gate.ts:estimateExitGateCost, and test/evals/exit-gate.test.ts recomputes it and fails on drift. There is deliberately no scored_against block: an estimate that carried one would pin a model that never ran.
output_projection: each op at its route maxOutputTokens ceiling — the direction a run cannot exceed while believing it is inside the estimate
vision_workload_basis: items = the 8 committed gold images in evals/fixtures/transcription.ts; input per item = IMAGE_INPUT_TOKENS (src/ai/routing.ts) plus the transcription prompt at the gateway’s four-characters-per-token estimate. See docs/research/2026-08-13-ocr-phase-cost.md for what the image figure assumes and what would settle it.
